arrival_regions.reading: the arrival efficiency is read with the authored RR: a region per case over the intrinsic RR, linear in it and in the demand ratio. With the model's arrival RR (acid drive only) the reading would absorb the drive gap (the opioid would read as a mechanical failure); the asthma migration must map availability and the excitatory drive before it maps mechanics
arrival_regions.rule: Predeclared, at each carried intrinsic RR (12 / 16 / 20, the same for every case): (a) the severe cases (oedema 58m, asthma 49m) below compensated asthma 24f; (b) asthma 24f below every reference without major mechanics impairment (GI 57m, GI 72f, ACS 70f); (c) opioid 35m not below the lowest of those references (mechanics relatively preserved). PE is informative only. Coherent when (a), (b) and (c) hold at every level; otherwise STOP with a semantic problem. Regions across different intrinsic RRs may overlap; that is reported as an identifiability limit, never decided here

integration_refuses_w_writes: respiratory_mechanics_active(profile) and any((delta.channel is Channel.W for delta in deltas))

decisions.ARRIVAL_MECHANICS_LATENT: a CASE / FAMILY LATENT ARRIVAL MAPPING constrained by the authored RR, the authored PaCO2, the intrinsic-RR uncertainty and the demand; never from the disease label; regions reported, no value selected
decisions.COMBINED_FORM: frequency factor = expressed RR / intrinsic RR; capacity = frequency factor x mechanics efficiency; W = capacity / metabolic demand ratio; PaCO2 = PaCO2_reference / W
decisions.DOMAIN: mechanics_efficiency > 0 only; 1 is STRUCTURAL_REFERENCE / DEFAULT, never a universal normal value; no upper bound (a stricter one would need faculty review)
decisions.MINIMAL_MECHANICS_COORDINATE: one common state-like quantity, mechanics_efficiency: the effectiveness of each expressed breath in producing alveolar ventilation relative to a eupnoeic reference; family-writable; distinct from drive, central depression, G and L; not a canonical channel
decisions.PACO2_REFERENCE: 40 mmHg, COMMON_REFERENCE_PROVISIONAL, not FACULTY_APPROVED; the resting PaCO2 is never anchored to the authored arrival PaCO2
decisions.STOP_BEFORE: asthma migration; mechanics calibration; hypoventilation -> oxygenation; fatigue state; NIV; the alveolar gas equation; HR / distress sympathetic implementation; opioid migration
decisions.UNIQUE_W_SEMANTICS: W = effective alveolar ventilation relative to the current metabolic ventilatory need, derived; never drive, frequency, central availability or mechanics severity. Drive + availability -> expressed RR; RR + mechanics efficiency + need -> W; W -> PaCO2; no W -> RR
decisions.W_SEMANTICS_COMMON_GAP: P2K-2 (W tied to RR) loses high RR with high PaCO2; P2K-3 (W free of RR) loses low-RR hypoventilation: neither pure reading is enough

dimensions.equivalence: the core computes W = efficiency x RR / intrinsic / demand (alveolar_ventilation, the one W formula, P2K-2's), algebraically the faculty's form; no dimensionally cleaner equivalent exists

interface.composition: the core multiplies the efficiency the minute starts with by every factor of the minute (RESPIRATORY_MECHANICS, a core composition, no kinetics): it stays where its writers leave it
interface.families: no family writer exists: no asthma obstruction, oedema mechanics or opioid writer (P2S-2-4)
interface.off: with the candidate off a change, an arrival value other than 1 and a state value other than 1 are refused (nothing would read them)
interface.provenance: each change in MinuteRecord.mechanics with its source; the aux change under RESPIRATORY_MECHANICS; the conservation check holds the efficiency to exactly its recorded factors
interface.writer: Contribution.mechanics: a tuple of provenance.MechanicsChange(factor > 0, source, minute, description); any non-reserved source kind (a family module, an order, a scripted probe)

design.ordering_rule: Predeclared, at each carried intrinsic RR (12 / 16 / 20, the same for every case): (a) the severe cases (oedema 58m, asthma 49m) below compensated asthma 24f; (b) asthma 24f below every reference without major mechanics impairment (GI 57m, GI 72f, ACS 70f); (c) opioid 35m not below the lowest of those references (mechanics relatively preserved). PE is informative only. Coherent when (a), (b) and (c) hold at every level; otherwise STOP with a semantic problem. Regions across different intrinsic RRs may overlap; that is reported as an identifiability limit, never decided here

parameter_status.arrival_mechanics_efficiency: CASE / FAMILY LATENT ARRIVAL MAPPING, UNSET in every committed case
parameter_status.mechanics_efficiency_clinical_values: UNSET (1 the STRUCTURAL_REFERENCE; synthetic values in probes only)

P2K2_path: every migration profile (acid-base on, mechanics off); unchanged
P2K3_candidate: clinical_core/ventilation.py (W from the acid recruitment, no RR term), off, unchanged for its closed records; superseded as W semantics: RETIRED from the common candidate
P2S2_candidate: profile.respiratory_mechanics, off by default: W from RR, the state's mechanics efficiency and the demand; PaCO2 from W and the common reference
PaCO2_P2K2: resting PaCO2 = authored arrival PaCO2 x arrival W at the reference (the arrival anchor); the P2K-2 path whenever the mechanics candidate is off; the candidate never reads it
W_P2K2: Respiration.ventilation = efficiency x RR / intrinsic / demand ratio with the profile constant; the P2K-2 path whenever the mechanics candidate is off
W_channel_P2K1_reader: derived.respiratory_rate reads state.W (above 0 multiplies the ventilatory RR, below 0 depresses it) only with the acid-base physiology off (DEFAULT_PROFILE, the golden); with it on that RR is replaced by P2K-2's. In the P2S-2 candidate RETIRED_FROM_COMMON_MECHANICS_CANDIDATE: no source may write the W channel (the integration refuses it) and nothing reads it; historical behaviour kept
acid_drive: P2K-2: the burden from the authored HCO3 and the effective oxygen deficit; unchanged
central_drive_availability: P2P-2 STRUCTURAL_INPUT, 1 by default; family values UNSET; it moves the RR only
expressed_rr: availability x rate_from_drive(excitatory, intrinsic) whenever the acid-base physiology is on; P2S-2 begins after it
intrinsic_rr: Anchors.intrinsic_respiratory_rate (None: the arrival RR), a P2K-2 candidate input (12 / 16 / 20 carried); the reference frequency of W, never a mechanics input
legacy_engine: family_engine.py's respiratory model, the runtime source of truth; not read
metabolic_demand: aux.oxygen_demand / anchors.metabolic_demand_baseline (BASELINE_RELATIVE), shared by P2K-2, P2K-3 and the candidate; CO2 production read proportional to it (a constant respiratory quotient, implicit)
respiratory_drive: P2P-2 composition: excitatory drive = acid drive (acid_to_drive_gain x burden) + hypoxaemic drive (UNSET by default); unchanged; reads no mechanics, W or PaCO2
ventilation_efficiency: P2K-2 profile constant, STRUCTURAL_REFERENCE 1 in every migration; in the P2S-2 candidate RETIRED: it must be 1, mechanics live in the state

probes.M1: normal drive + availability 1 + mechanics reference: the W reference state (W 1, PaCO2 the reference)
probes.M10: a mechanics change alone moves no drive, intrinsic RR, availability, G, SpO2, D or lactate
probes.M11: a G impairment alone does not change the mechanics efficiency
probes.M12: an L impairment alone does not change the mechanics efficiency unless a writer declares it
probes.M2: RR up, mechanics fixed: W up, PaCO2 down
probes.M3: RR high + mechanics sufficiently reduced: W can stay low, PaCO2 high (the asthma / oedema property)
probes.M4: RR low from central depression + mechanics normal: W low, PaCO2 high (the opioid property)
probes.M5: same RR, lower mechanics: higher PaCO2
probes.M6: same mechanics, lower RR: higher PaCO2
probes.M7: the acid drive raises RR; W responds through RR only, no direct lactate control
probes.M8: the hypoxaemic drive raises RR; W responds through RR only, no SpO2 -> PaCO2 shortcut
probes.M9: central depression suppresses RR: W falls, PaCO2 rises

readiness_criteria: RR and mechanics are distinct (M5, M6, M10; the drive reads no mechanics; the mechanics read no drive)
both contribute to W (M1, M2, M3, M5; the directions, demand included; the faculty's form reproduced)
W has one meaning (W channel writes refused and the channel inert, RR never read from W, W after RR; P2K-1 retired from the candidate)
high RR / high PaCO2 representable (M3; oedema 58m and asthma 49m; availability 1)
low RR / high PaCO2 representable (M4, M9; the opioid contrast)
central depression remains distinct from mechanics (the opioid contrast; M10, M11, M12)
arrival PaCO2 not hidden in a case-specific reference anchor (no anchor absorption; arrival ordering coherent)
default prior behaviour unchanged (exact P2Q-2 reading; GI, ACS, oedema, PE and P2P-2 reproduced; the P2Q-2 tree proven)
no clinical mechanics value approved (no family writer; committed arrivals at the reference; parameter state)
design.readiness_rule: Predeclared. READY when every criterion holds; otherwise NOT_READY with the first failing criterion as the blocker. An incoherent arrival ordering (P2S-2-11) is a STOP: it fails the seventh criterion. The region overlaps, the frequency-factor linearity and the HR gap are reported and never decide it
